description: High Quality Transit Stops is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. Use GTFS schedule trips, stoptimes, shapes, and stops to estimate whether corridor segments have scheduled headways of 20 minutes or less. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Transportation, Land Use, Transit-Oriented Development, TOD, High Quality Transit, Transit. Caltrans, California Department of Transportation, CAOpenData. The bounding box given is -123.0119,32.5428,-114.6062,41.2111. The hub shows 2026-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
